MeteringDeliveryLookup.description: What OLP can prove about one priced attempt's delivery to one CloudEvents metering sink. Accepted means the sink answered 2xx and OLP recorded it. Delivery unconfirmed means retries ended after a send may have occurred without a recorded acknowledgement. No payload or destination is included.

attempt_id.description: Attempt id, which is also the CloudEvents event id

attempts.description: Delivery claims made for this attempt on this sink, or null when no evidence remains

event_id.description: Durable export record id sent as X-OLP-Event-ID, or null when no evidence remains

last_attempt_at.description: When the most recent delivery claim was made, or null

last_error_code.description: Safe category of the most recent delivery failure, or null

occurred_at.description: When the priced attempt was observed, or null when no evidence remains

outcome.description: pending or retrying while queued, accepted after a recorded 2xx, delivery_unconfirmed when retries ended after a possible send, expired_before_delivery when evidence rules out every send, no_retained_evidence when nothing attempt-specific remains in scope

queued_at.description: When the export record was queued, or null when no evidence remains

settled_at.description: When delivery was recorded as accepted or the receipt reached its terminal state, or null while queued

row_count.description: Null until the dataset has been generated.

part_count.description: Null until the dataset has been generated.

commitment_totals.description: Null for legacy datasets awaiting regeneration and charge-basis datasets.

CommitmentTotals.description: Exact commitment totals for periods touching this dataset. Scoped exports disclose only their allocated cost; purchase and unused totals are zero. Completeness includes historical evidence and export-window coverage.

ObservabilityRunEvidence.description: Gateway-observed run metadata exported by an observability sink.

ObservabilityTraceSpanEvidence.description: Client-asserted trace span metadata exported by an observability sink.

ObservabilityRunEvidenceEvent.description: Observability sink evidence envelope. The same object appears as a JSONL line or an OTLP log body.
